bible_verses.english: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.

They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book, and to open its seals: for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood, out of every tribe and language and people and nation,
For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, we admit that our hearts often ache over the pain and darkness in this world. Thank You that Your light shines undimmed in the deepest shadows and that You hold all our hope in Your hands. Help us to keep our eyes on You, trusting that You are faithfully working to make everything new. You alone are worthy of our praise, our trust, and our lives. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: We all feel the heavy weight of a broken world, where shadows often seem to deepen around us. Yet, as we lift our voices together, we are reminded of a greater truth: the darkness has never overcome the light of Jesus. He hears our longing for renewal and invites us to anchor our hearts in His ultimate victory. Today, let your honest aches turn into joyful expectation, knowing that Christ alone is worthy to make all things new.
